test.title: — Kishōtenketsu Chapter Arc (No Conflict Structure)
test.prompt:
Create a chapter outline for Chapter 4 of "The Signal Beneath" using Kishōtenketsu.
  This should be a quieter chapter — the protagonist reaches the coast and
  observes the submerged station from the shore. No combat, no confrontation.
  Focus on contrast and reflection.
test.prerequisite: R110; "Kishōtenketsu" in `story_arcs_v2`; no outline for Ch4
expected: arc_beat values = Ki/Shō/Ten/Ketsu; no forced conflict beats; Ten = contrast/revelation (not combat); connects_to_book_arc still references Hero's Journey Ch4 stage; Kishōtenketsu prompt loaded; CR-009 email

response.assistant_message: Planning chapter 4 for "The Signal Beneath" using Kishōtenketsu. I'll let you know when the outline is ready.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: The Shape of the Morning
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: POV character moves through an established morning routine — a specific sequence of small acts (window, kettle, threshold) that reveals the texture of their ordinary life without urgency or problem.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: POV character moves through an established morning routine — a specific sequence of small acts (window, kettle, threshold) that reveals the texture of their ordinary life without urgency or problem.
sub_chapter_briefs.arc_beat: Ki — Introduction: invite the reader into the world through sensory presence; no conflict, pure atmosphere.
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: The POV character's home, early morning.
sub_chapter_briefs.emotional_tone: Quiet, grounded, unhurried — the feeling of a life that has settled into its own rhythm.
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: Establishes the baseline state of the POV character's world before any disruption; anchors the reader in the book's central emotional register.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: What the Day Holds
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: The POV character moves outward — into a street, a workplace, a shared space — and the world grows more specific: a recurring face, a small exchange, a detail noticed but not yet understood.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: The POV character moves outward — into a street, a workplace, a shared space — and the world grows more specific: a recurring face, a small exchange, a detail noticed but not yet understood.
sub_chapter_briefs.arc_beat: Shō — Development: widen the lens; deepen texture through repetition and layered observation rather than new plot.
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: A public or semi-public space the POV character frequents — street, market, office, café.
sub_chapter_briefs.emotional_tone: Gently curious, observational — the world is familiar but not yet fully legible.
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: Deepens the reader's understanding of the POV character's place in the world; plants at least one image or detail that will be recalled in the Ten and Ketsu acts.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: The Same as Always
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: A routine interaction or task unfolds — something the POV character has done many times — but this time a small, specific detail is slightly different: a word used, an object out of place, a silence where there is usually sound.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: A routine interaction or task unfolds — something the POV character has done many times — but this time a small, specific detail is slightly different: a word used, an object out of place, a silence where there is usually sound.
sub_chapter_briefs.arc_beat: Shō — Development (continued): the widening lens catches a hairline crack in the ordinary; not a problem, just a texture shift.
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: Continuous from sub-chapter 2, or a closely adjacent space.
sub_chapter_briefs.emotional_tone: Still calm, but with a faint undercurrent — the reader senses something without being able to name it.
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: Introduces the small story turn that will escalate: a detail noticed but not acted on (a lie, a misplaced object, an overheard fragment) — START of the escalating thread. Reappearance with greater pressure: Chapter 7. Explosion: Chapter 12.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: The Corner Turned
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: A single unexpected thing arrives — not a crisis, but a reframing: a stranger's remark, a letter, a memory triggered by an object, a view seen from a new angle — that re-contextualises everything the reader has witnessed in this chapter.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: A single unexpected thing arrives — not a crisis, but a reframing: a stranger's remark, a letter, a memory triggered by an object, a view seen from a new angle — that re-contextualises everything the reader has witnessed in this chapter.
sub_chapter_briefs.arc_beat: Ten — Twist/Turn: one quiet revelation that reframes Ki and Shō without destroying them; the surprise should feel like finding something beautiful around a corner.
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: The same world, but a slightly different vantage point — a back room, a window seat, an unexpected detour.
sub_chapter_briefs.emotional_tone: A soft inhale — wonder, mild disorientation, the pleasure of seeing something familiar made strange.
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: The Ten revelation shifts the reader's understanding of the POV character's role in the book-level arc; raises the new dramatic question that propels the reader into Chapter 5.

sub_chapter_briefs.title: The Long Exhale
sub_chapter_briefs.beat: The POV character returns to a gesture or image from sub-chapter 1 — the window, the kettle, the threshold — but it is held differently now; the chapter closes on that image without explanation, letting the resonance do the work.
sub_chapter_briefs.brief: The POV character returns to a gesture or image from sub-chapter 1 — the window, the kettle, the threshold — but it is held differently now; the chapter closes on that image without explanation, letting the resonance do the work.
sub_chapter_briefs.arc_beat: Ketsu — Conclusion/Resolution: echo the Ki opening image in a new light; end with restraint — a gesture, a silence, not a summary.
sub_chapter_briefs.setting: Back at or near the POV character's home, or a space that mirrors the opening.
sub_chapter_briefs.emotional_tone: A long exhale — not resolution, but resonance; the reader feels the chapter's meaning without being told it.
sub_chapter_briefs.connects_to_book_arc: Closes the chapter's emotional loop while leaving the escalating story turn from sub-chapter 3 unresolved and quietly present; the final image plants a seed for the book's larger Ten act later.
